breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained a contradiction by specifying both periodic and Dirichlet boundary conditions for a periodic domain. The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly identifies the domain as periodic and omits the incorrect Dirichlet condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
